Take the instrument itself in your hands and set it vibrating by striking, shaking, scraping or plucking; different parts and different amounts of force give different timbres. Begin by settling into the correct hold on the instrument, and once the basic way of sounding it is secure, work on rhythm patterns and melodies. Strike the surface with a finger or a drumstick and let the rebound lift it naturally, keeping the wrist loose.

竹木琴是起源於東南亞的打擊樂器，由排列整齊的竹片或木片組成，下方配置共鳴體。演奏: The bamboo xylophone is a percussion instrument from Southeast Asia, made of neatly ranged bamboo or wooden bars with resonators beneath. The player strikes the bars with wooden mallets. Its timbre is crisp and bright, light and nimble, and its range spans two to three octaves. It is widely used in folk music performance, religious rites and education, and stands out in ensembles for its warm, approachable tone and good projection; it is an important instrument for showing a people's musical character.
竹木琴為體鳴樂器，來源僅標示其為竹製木琴，故可確認發聲體使用竹材；至於琴身及其他: The bamboo xylophone is an idiophone; the source describes it only as a bamboo xylophone, so the sounding bodies can be confirmed as bamboo, while the materials of the frame and other parts are not stated. It is used in the traditional music of the Gia Rai and Ba Na peoples of the central highlands of Vietnam, and later became the instrument representing highland minority music in Vietnamese traditional ensembles.
竹木琴起源於東南亞地區，尤其在印尼、馬來西亞和泰國等地有悠久的使用傳統。這種樂器: The bamboo xylophone comes from Southeast Asia, and has a long tradition of use in Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand in particular. It is made of ranged bamboo or wooden bars with resonators beneath, and the player strikes it with wooden mallets. Its earliest form can be traced back several hundred years in folk culture, and it was closely tied to local religious rites and everyday entertainment.
竹木琴音色清脆明亮，具有輕盈靈動的質感。其音域通常跨越兩至三個八度，高音部分尖銳: The bamboo xylophone's timbre is crisp and bright, light and nimble. Its range usually spans two to three octaves: the treble is sharp and penetrating, the middle soft and gentle, the bass deep and strong. Because the bars are bamboo or wood, their vibration gives a natural resonance of its own, and the tone carries the warmth of the material. Compared with the dry snap of a metal xylophone the bamboo xylophone is more approachable; compared with the marimba its volume is softer but the tone clearer and more transparent. Being an idiophone, it projects well and stands out clearly in an ensemble while keeping its friendly national character, and it is widely used in folk music and in education.
隨著時間推移，竹木琴的製作工藝不斷完善，音色品質也逐漸提升。在19世紀至20世紀: Over time the craft of making the bamboo xylophone has improved and the quality of its sound has risen. In the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries the instrument reached Europe along trade routes, where it drew the interest of musicians and instrument makers. Many Western composers began to bring bamboo-xylophone elements into orchestral works, and it gradually became an internationally recognised percussion instrument. Today it is an important tool in music education and folk-music performance around the world.
